corrected_by: Opus 5, read directly from the recorded instrument (pages 16-18)
basis: Read from the RECORDED INSTRUMENT, Collin County doc 20091012001256060 filed 2009-10-12, not from any transcription. Two defects, and only one of them is ours. (1) OUR READINGS: the reviewed sheet retyped course 7 as South 11 24 24 East where the instrument reads South 13 24 24 East -- a 2-degree error on a 289.82 ft course, about 10 ft of displacement, and the course is exactly parallel to the North 13 24 24 West ell jog four calls above it, as the survey geometry requires. (2) THE INSTRUMENT ITSELF omits the arc call for its final R=1985 curve: the recital ends 'a tangent of 23.14 feet' and the next line jumps to the closing course, where all seven sibling crossings carry a following 'THENCE ... (Chord Bearing ...)' line. A 2009 scrivener's omission, unrecoverable by re-reading. Reconstructed from the siblings' relative geometry and then CONFIRMED by the deed rather than fitted to it: with course 7 correct the traverse's own misclosure is 46.28 ft, and the curve's chord from 2R*sin(delta/2) is 46.28 ft -- the same figure to the hundredth. The 534.00 ft of course 3 is exactly as recorded; an earlier 543.00 transposition hypothesis reproduced the acreage and was still a fiction, and is retired.
repairs: course 7 bearing South 11 24 24 East -> South 13 24 24 East (per the instrument)
R=1985 curve: missing arc call reconstructed, chord 46.28 ft at azimuth 90.606 from 3 siblings agreeing to 0.07 deg
RETIRED: the 534.00 -> 543.00 transposition hypothesis. The instrument reads 534.00.

evidence.chord_confirmed_by: the traverse's own misclosure with course 7 corrected was 46.28 ft, against 2R*sin(delta/2) = 46.28 ft -- the deed demands the east chord rather than merely permitting it
evidence.tangency_reading_withdrawn: an earlier objection put the chord at azimuth 180.94 by assuming tangency to the incoming course; the instrument recites 'to a point on a curve' and tangency would exit S 01 36 23 W where the next call reads S 00 25 11 W
evidence.credit: Fable 5 identified the course-7 misread and the tangent relabelling from the same pages, and retracted its own 543.00 hypothesis

the_plat_the_TIE_needs.why: tract 3's POB is the southwest corner of The Heights at Westridge Phase III and courses 5-7 run with its WEST LINE -- that platted line, not the assessor's rendering of it, is what the 10.78 ft tie residual and the -0.75 deg preference have to be tested against

amendment_that_may_supersede_it.why_it_matters: filed five weeks after #3; covid 4981's declaration was recorded 2009-10-12, so the covenant runs with the AMENDED line. Reading 2007/554 alone risks a confident answer from a superseded plat.

plat_references.index_naming_trap: Collin's plat index spells this subdivision 'HEIGHTS WESTRIDGE #3'; the deed says 'The Heights at Westridge Phase III' and the CAD says 'HEIGHTS AT WESTRIDGE PHASE III THE'. Searches on the deed's phrasing return ZERO rows and were briefly read as 'the plat is not indexed'. Search the base name and filter.

evidence.tie_status: tract 3 is anchored on the Phase III adjoining-plat tie and that placement is INDEPENDENTLY CORROBORATED: its POB lands 13.3 ft from Collin's published southwest corner of Heights at Westridge Phase III -- which is what the deed says the POB IS -- and 12 of covid 4981's 88 census parcels fall inside it, with the tract touching the Phase III footprint (1,938 sq ft overlap). Neither check depends on the fit that produced the placement. The 10.78 ft residual is therefore a statement about fit quality along 414 ft of contact, NOT about gross position, and the four dead hypotheses about it matter less than they appeared to.

stated_coordinate_rejected.marks: read at 400 dpi: the leader terminates at the south end of a 00-25-11 160.38 ft course
stated_coordinate_rejected.why_rejected: that is NOT tract 3's closing 160.38 ft course. Placing tract 3's POB there puts it 4,470 ft from Phase III's published SW corner, 1,493 ft clear of the Phase III footprint, and containing 0 of 88 census parcels. Two courses of the same bearing and the same length exist ~4,470 ft apart in a development full of repeated street-crossing geometry; the coincidence was treated as an identity.
stated_coordinate_rejected.do_not_retry: not without first matching the coordinate to a vertex of the PLAT's own recited traverse (sheet 2), then relating that to tract 3 through the shared line
